answer_1.quote: We build a general-purpose, interactive agent to master tasks from open-domain natural language instructions on websites.
answer_1.outputs: RUSS generates executable actions (e.g., @click, @enter, @ask) from natural language instructions, enabling dialogue-based interaction with web agents.

answer_2.quote: We measure Exact Match Accuracy: a parse is considered correct only if it matches the gold annotation token by token.

answer_4.quote: We recruited 12 participants who were asked to complete 5 customer-support tasks... and gave each participant an exit survey containing qualitative assessments.
answer_4.guideline: Participants were asked to complete tasks using both RUSS and the browser, and were given an exit survey with qualitative assessments; time, number of turns/clicks, and preferences were recorded.
